property_summary: For any two admissible fallback calls where the second is made in a block number divisible by 15, in the reference contract the second call must revert because pastBlockTime does not change when calls are in the same block, so the block.timestamp > pastBlockTime check fails; the mutant removes the check and allows the second call to succeed, causing a state difference.
change_summary: Delete the second require statement to allow multiple calls in the same block.
